nodes.description: Mapping address => SwapOption (enabled, burn, price) controlling which tokens can be swapped and at what price.
Global flag _enabled gating swapTokensForCredits via the isEnabled modifier.
initialize() sets up Ownable and UUPS upgradeability for the proxy; protected by initializer.
_authorizeUpgrade(address) override restricted with onlyOwner; gates the UUPS upgrade path.
tokenSwapOption(address) view returning the SwapOption struct for a token contract.
swapTokensForCredits(int256,address) computes value from price and pulls/burns tokens from the caller; external token interaction.
giftCredits(address,int256) owner-only credit issuance emitting CreditsChanged.
setTokenSwapOption(address,bool,bool,uint256) owner-only configuration of per-token swap options.
withdrawTokens(address,uint256) owner-only token withdrawal from the contract via safeTransferFrom.
setEnabled(bool) owner-only toggling of the global credits-swapping switch.
msg.sender accessed indirectly via _msgSender(); used as swap account, credit owner and owner check.
Value computation (uint256(amount) * option.price) / 10**18 in swapTokensForCredits - unchecked multiplication of caller amount by configured price.
External call to untrusted token contract inside swapTokensForCredits: IERC20Burn.burnFrom or IERC20Upgradeable.safeTransferFrom.
External call in withdrawTokens: safeTransferFrom on an owner-supplied token contract with msg.sender as destination.
amount (int256) parameter of swapTokensForCredits; scaled by price into value.
tokenContract (address) parameter of swapTokensForCredits; selects the SwapOption and call target.
tokenContract (address) parameter of the tokenSwapOption view.
account (address) parameter of giftCredits; recipient recorded in CreditsChanged.
amount (int256) parameter of giftCredits, validated by validAmount.
tokenContract (address) parameter of setTokenSwapOption.
enabled (bool) parameter of setTokenSwapOption.
burn (bool) parameter of setTokenSwapOption controlling burnFrom vs transferFrom path.
price (uint256) parameter of setTokenSwapOption, bounded by uint128 max.
tokenContract (address) parameter of withdrawTokens; target of the external call.
amount (uint256) parameter of withdrawTokens.
newImplementation (address) parameter of _authorizeUpgrade; unchecked in the override body.
enabled (bool) parameter of setEnabled.
Storage pointer option = _tokenSwapOptions[tokenContract] in swapTokensForCredits, source of price/burn/enabled.
Local value = (uint256(amount) * option.price) / 10**18 used as the token transfer/burn amount.
Local account = _msgSender() in swapTokensForCredits, used as the token source.

_tokenSwapOptions mapping supplies the price used in the value computation.

Computed value is passed as the amount of the external burnFrom/safeTransferFrom call.
Result of the arithmetic operation flows directly into the external token call.
msg.sender is assigned to the local account variable.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external token transfer in withdrawTokens.
Owner-supplied tokenContract is the target of the external safeTransferFrom call.
amount parameter is forwarded as the value of the external token call.

account parameter is emitted as the credited account in giftCredits.
amount parameter is emitted as the credited amount in giftCredits.
tokenContract keys the SwapOption write in setTokenSwapOption.
enabled parameter is written into the SwapOption struct.
burn parameter is written into the SwapOption struct.
price parameter is validated and cast to uint128 into the SwapOption struct.

amount parameter is the quantity withdrawn in withdrawTokens.
newImplementation is the argument of the upgrade authorization override.
enabled parameter is stored into the global _enabled flag.
_enabled state variable gates swapTokensForCredits via the isEnabled modifier.
_tokenSwapOptions mapping is read to build the option used in swapTokensForCredits.
_tokenSwapOptions mapping is read by the tokenSwapOption view.
_tokenSwapOptions mapping is written by setTokenSwapOption.
swapTokensForCredits executes the value computation before any external interaction.
swapTokensForCredits branches into the external burnFrom/safeTransferFrom call.
withdrawTokens performs the external safeTransferFrom call.
onlyOwner on _authorizeUpgrade compares owner() with _msgSender().
onlyOwner gates giftCredits through the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates setTokenSwapOption through the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates withdrawTokens through the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates setEnabled through the caller identity.
Malicious token contract called by swapTokensForCredits can re-enter swapTokensForCredits before state/effects settle.
Malicious token contract called by withdrawTokens can re-enter withdrawTokens during the external transfer.
